verdict.rationale: Omnirush is a desktop coding-agent app backed by an omnirush.ai account and hosted model catalog, so data region/residency is a fair question for it, but the evidence documents no region or residency selection. The `--password-store` flag only picks a local Linux credential keyring, and bring-your-own provider keys are a different feature; neither controls where data is stored by region.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
